description: HP-75 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) located in Jubbal, under the Shimla district of Himachal Pradesh. Managed by the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), this office handles local vehicle registration series and driving license issuance for the Jubbal subdivision. It is a critical administrative unit for transport services in this apple-growing region of the state.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Jubbal, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
